correctness.rationale: For the zero-based unshifted fixed point, p(2a)=0 and p(2a+1)=1−p(a). This excludes 11, then 0000, which would require adjacent parent 1s. Thus equal factors of length n>=4 have the same start parity, since opposite parities would force four zeros. Same-parity equality is exactly parent-factor equality at length floor(n/2) for even starts and ceil(n/2) for odd starts. The first even collision is at 2I(floor(n/2)), strictly before the first odd collision at 2I(ceil(n/2))+1 by length monotonicity, and its earlier position also doubles. The prefix 0100010 gives the base (i,j) pairs (0,2), (2,3), (0,4); uniqueness follows because every start before j has a distinct factor. Iteration yields the two dyadic branches and both witness coordinates. The two limits follow by taking n at the dyadic left endpoint and just before the right endpoint, respectively for the upper and lower limits. Analytic replay: RESULT.md:29–52. VERIFICATION.md and verify.py were inspected; their recorded finite checks do not replace the induction and were not rerun.
